scenarios.hypothesis: Optimized code continues to trust synthetic type or shape feedback from generation N after a controlled shape transition advances the dependency generation to N+1.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A synthetic toy runtime and read-only shadow-value consumer emit only a generation-tagged semantic receipt when stale optimized code returns the wrong inert value.
scenarios.positive_control: The same toy program under current feedback generation N+1 produces the baseline/reference value while remaining in the intended optimized tier and pass.
scenarios.negative_control: The same payload with optimization disabled at the single suspect pass returns the baseline value, while unrelated optimized passes remain active for isolation.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture leaves the local owned sandbox, depends on uncontrolled external state, or would require weaponized exploitation rather than bounded semantic proof.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After registering or honoring the current dependency generation, stale optimized code is retired or guarded and the optimized result reconverges with baseline.
scenarios.runtime_program_tier_generation: Record runtime/build flags, exact synthetic program/input generation, function identity, warmup/profile generation, optimized tier, and optimized code generation.
scenarios.feedback_speculation_dependency: Bind old shape feedback generation N, speculative type/shape invariant, dependency registration, expected invalidation, and code generation consuming the stale fact.
scenarios.guard_invalidation_transform_trace: Capture pre-pass IR, suspect specialization pass, shape guard or dependency, controlled shape transition, invalidation generation, transform, and first wrong semantic operation.
scenarios.osr_inlining_specialization_state: Record whether OSR or inlining participates, the specialization generation, transferred environment state, and prove those dimensions remain constant across controls.
scenarios.deopt_frame_state_reconstruction: Record whether deopt should trigger after the shape transition, which metadata generation is selected, and whether reconstructed values are baseline-equivalent.
scenarios.baseline_reference_semantics: Use the same deterministic program/input in baseline/reference mode to establish the language-level result before comparing the optimized stale-feedback execution.
scenarios.downstream_semantic_consumer: Identify the read-only shadow-value consumer that observes the optimized wrong value without performing any memory corruption, external write, or privileged action.
scenarios.effective_optimized_divergence_capabilit: The demonstrated capability is limited to one deterministic wrong synthetic semantic value caused by stale feedback in an owner-controlled optimized execution.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a read-only receipt containing old/current feedback generations, optimized code generation, baseline value, optimized value, and no external effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate runtime/build, program generation, tier/code generation, stale feedback, suspect pass, invalidation state, first divergence, consumer, and receipt in one record.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold program, input, warmup, tier, downstream consumer, and all unrelated passes constant while changing only stale versus current dependency/feedback generation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject permitted language semantics, hidden input drift, tier fallback, unrelated type confusion, changed pass activation, or a receipt from another execution generation.
scenarios.evidence_level: JIT3 because a read-only semantic consumer observes a deterministic optimized-only wrong value while the same program remains correct in baseline/reference execution.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: JIT3 maximum until a bounded optimized effect plus complete dependency, invalidation, pass, counterfactual, receipt, and remediation evidence justify JIT4 or JIT5.

scenarios.hypothesis: An optimization reuses a synthetic range fact across a modeled side effect that invalidates the fact, causing optimized execution to choose the wrong inert branch or value.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled mock optimizer fixture and read-only range consumer expose only an inert branch/value mismatch; no real out-of-bounds access or unsafe memory operation occurs.
scenarios.positive_control: The same synthetic function with the side-effect-invalidated range fact refreshed or guarded produces the baseline/reference branch while preserving optimized-tier activation.
scenarios.negative_control: A side effect that is explicitly proven not to modify the range dependency leaves the optimization valid and produces the same result in baseline and optimized modes.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture leaves the local owned sandbox, depends on uncontrolled external state, or would require weaponized exploitation rather than bounded semantic proof.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After adding the required dependency, clobber, or guard, the suspect pass no longer reuses the stale range fact and optimized output matches baseline.
scenarios.runtime_program_tier_generation: Record build, toy program/input, function generation, baseline execution, warmup, optimized tier/code generation, and the exact optimization pipeline/pass identity.
scenarios.feedback_speculation_dependency: Bind the range feedback/fact generation, speculative invariant, side-effect dependency, alias/clobber model, and code generation that consumes the stale fact.
scenarios.guard_invalidation_transform_trace: Capture the side-effecting operation, range-transform pass, missing or ineffective invalidation/guard, transformed branch/value, and first baseline/optimized semantic divergence.
scenarios.osr_inlining_specialization_state: Record OSR, inlining, and specialization state and prove no hidden tier or callee-generation change explains the result across positive and negative controls.
scenarios.deopt_frame_state_reconstruction: Record whether the stale range should trigger deoptimization, the selected frame-state generation, and confirm deopt is not independently creating the wrong result.
scenarios.baseline_reference_semantics: Compute the deterministic mathematical/language-level result in baseline/reference execution without invoking unsafe memory access, then compare the optimized branch/value.
scenarios.downstream_semantic_consumer: Use a read-only semantic consumer that records the chosen branch or synthetic value and never converts the stale range fact into an out-of-bounds operation.
scenarios.effective_optimized_divergence_capabilit: The demonstrated capability is limited to one deterministic wrong branch or value under optimized execution after a controlled side effect invalidates the range fact.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is an inert receipt describing range fact generation, side-effect generation, pass identity, baseline result, optimized result, and no memory corruption.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Bind program/tier/code generation, stale range fact, side-effect dependency, guard/invalidation state, suspect transform, semantic consumer, and inert result receipt.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold input, tier, pass set, and consumer constant while changing only whether the modeled side effect invalidates or refreshes the speculative range dependency.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject independent integer overflow, bounds bug, input drift, undefined behavior, sanitizer-induced tier changes, concurrency, or different optimized code generation.
scenarios.evidence_level: JIT3 because optimized execution deterministically selects an incorrect inert branch/value from a stale range assumption while baseline/reference semantics remain correct.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: JIT3 maximum because no unsafe memory access is attempted; stronger promotion requires bounded causal effect plus complete pass/dependency/remediation provenance.

scenarios.hypothesis: A deoptimization path reconstructs a synthetic local or environment value using stale frame-state metadata from the wrong optimized-code generation.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A shadow frame-state consumer records only synthetic locals and environment values after deopt, providing a read-only deterministic oracle with no external side effect.
scenarios.positive_control: Current deopt metadata for the same optimized code generation reconstructs values that match the baseline/reference logical frame and produces the expected read-only receipt.
scenarios.negative_control: A deopt triggered at a different checkpoint with independently current metadata reconstructs the correct frame, showing the harness itself does not corrupt materialization.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture leaves the local owned sandbox, depends on uncontrolled external state, or would require weaponized exploitation rather than bounded semantic proof.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After binding deopt metadata to the current optimized-code generation and materialization recipe, reconstructed locals match baseline/reference semantics on replay.
scenarios.runtime_program_tier_generation: Record runtime/build, synthetic program/input, function generation, optimized tier/code generation, deopt generation, and resumed execution tier identity.
scenarios.feedback_speculation_dependency: Record the speculation or guard that triggers deopt, relevant feedback/dependency generation, and prove those facts only determine the exit rather than the wrong frame value.
scenarios.guard_invalidation_transform_trace: Capture the optimization transform and guard leading to deopt, the exact trigger, and show the first semantic divergence begins during reconstruction rather than earlier.
scenarios.osr_inlining_specialization_state: Record inlined frames, OSR state, specialization generation, and the logical frame hierarchy expected at the deopt checkpoint for both baseline and optimized paths.
scenarios.deopt_frame_state_reconstruction: Bind deopt trigger identity, metadata/frame-state generation, materialization recipe, expected logical locals/environment, reconstructed values, conversions, and resumed tier.
scenarios.baseline_reference_semantics: Establish the expected local/environment values using deterministic baseline/reference execution at the equivalent semantic checkpoint before comparing deopt reconstruction.
scenarios.downstream_semantic_consumer: Identify the shadow read-only post-deopt consumer that observes the reconstructed synthetic local or environment value and emits the deterministic mismatch receipt.
scenarios.effective_optimized_divergence_capabilit: The demonstrated capability is limited to one wrong reconstructed synthetic logical value after deoptimization in an owner-controlled runtime fixture.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a shadow-state receipt containing expected and reconstructed values, code/deopt generations, frame-state metadata identity, and no unsafe effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate optimized code generation, deopt trigger, metadata generation, materialization recipe, baseline frame, reconstructed frame, consumer, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold program, checkpoint, optimized code, and consumer constant while changing only stale versus current deopt frame-state metadata generation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject an earlier optimizer wrong value, inlining mismatch, OSR mismatch, debug-only materialization behavior, permitted semantics, or another execution generation.
scenarios.evidence_level: JIT3 because a read-only shadow consumer observes deterministic wrong deopt-reconstructed logical state while the baseline/reference checkpoint state is correct.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: JIT3 maximum until a bounded downstream optimized effect and complete deopt-generation, alternative, receipt, counterfactual, and remediation proof justify promotion.

scenarios.hypothesis: OSR enters optimized code using a profile or speculative-assumption generation that does not match the current baseline state transferred at the OSR entry.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled toy program and inert read-only semantic consumer record only a wrong synthetic value after OSR, with deterministic tier confirmation and no unsafe memory behavior.
scenarios.positive_control: OSR with the current profile and transfer-state generation enters the same optimized tier and yields the baseline/reference result for the identical synthetic input.
scenarios.negative_control: Full-function optimized entry without OSR uses the current assumptions and returns the baseline value, isolating the divergence to the OSR transfer/generation boundary.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture leaves the local owned sandbox, depends on uncontrolled external state, or would require weaponized exploitation rather than bounded semantic proof.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After rebinding OSR entry to current profile and transfer-state generations or forcing revalidation, the optimized OSR path reconverges with baseline/reference semantics.
scenarios.runtime_program_tier_generation: Record build, program/input, function, baseline state generation, warmup/profile generation, OSR entry generation, optimized tier, and optimized code generation.
scenarios.feedback_speculation_dependency: Bind profile feedback, speculative invariant, assumption/dependency generation, and show the OSR code consumes an older generation than the transferred baseline state.
scenarios.guard_invalidation_transform_trace: Capture the guard or dependency expected at OSR entry, any omitted revalidation, optimization transform relying on the stale fact, and the first semantic divergence.
scenarios.osr_inlining_specialization_state: Bind exact OSR entry identity, locals/stack/environment transferred, profile generation, inlining/specialization generations, and exit/deopt targets.
scenarios.deopt_frame_state_reconstruction: Record whether deopt is triggered after the stale OSR assumption, which frame-state generation is used, and prove reconstruction is not the independent root cause.
scenarios.baseline_reference_semantics: Use deterministic baseline execution at the exact loop/function state corresponding to OSR entry to establish expected locals, control state, and final semantic value.
scenarios.downstream_semantic_consumer: Identify the inert read-only consumer that observes the wrong synthetic value after OSR and emits a receipt tagged with baseline and optimized generations.
scenarios.effective_optimized_divergence_capabilit: The demonstrated capability is limited to deterministic wrong synthetic semantics after a stale OSR assumption generation in an owner-controlled toy runtime.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is an inert receipt binding OSR entry, old/current profile generations, transferred state, optimized code generation, and expected/actual values.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate build, program, baseline state, OSR entry, profile generation, optimized code, guard/dependency, first divergence, consumer, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold program/input, loop state, optimized code target, and consumer constant while changing only stale versus current OSR profile/transfer-state generation binding.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject baseline state drift, full-function optimization bug, deopt reconstruction bug, inlining generation drift, concurrency, permitted semantics, or tier fallback.
scenarios.evidence_level: JIT3 because a deterministic read-only consumer observes optimized OSR-only semantic divergence while the equivalent baseline state produces the correct result.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: JIT3 maximum until a bounded causal optimized effect and complete OSR/dependency/pass/remediation provenance justify JIT4 or regression-verified JIT5.
